title: How CNNs process complex image patterns #cnn #deeplearning #ai #machinelearning #computervision
description:
How does a CNN actually recognize an image? 👀

CNNs learn visual patterns step by step — starting with edges and textures, then combining them into shapes and object parts, and finally using these features to recognize objects.

Think of it like building a picture from small pieces:

Pixels → Patterns → Features → Prediction

This is how Convolutional Neural Networks learn to understand images. 🚀
